subject: Weekly MAP finance readout + credit ask (ACME)
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@acme.com>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Weekly MAP finance readout + credit ask (ACME)

Hi Sanjay / Lena —

Quick weekly MAP checkpoint from our side ahead of Thursday's joint review:

Summary status:
- Evaluation: PoC (L7 latency test) complete; internal ACME engineering feedback positive.
- Proposed commercial: 12-month commit, target committed spend: $120,000 ARR (monthly billing cadence).
- Pricing ask from ACME: confirmation on discount + onboarding credit to offset initial POC work.

Specific request (what we need this week):
1) Credit ask: $30,000 one-time credit to be applied over first invoice cycle (split-capable if needed).
2) Discount: 15% off list for committed volume (applied to committed spend).
3) Contract timeline: target signature by 2026-11-15 to hit procurement window.

Attachments: ACME-MAP-v2.xlsx (updated milestones & deliverables), redwood-credit-summary.pdf (credit options & economics).

Action items / owners (from Redwood):
- Karthik: finalize term-sheet and a single-line credit offer; due by EOD Tuesday.
- Marissa: escalate finance approval for credit > $20k; update by Wednesday.
- Neha: prepare pricing rationale and fallback offers (extended trial / reduced credit); ready for Thursday call.

If the credit request is a blocker for procurement, let me know which amount would be acceptable and we can bake that into an alternate proposal.

Thanks — looking forward to the Thursday readout.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

--
Attachments: ACME-MAP-v2.xlsx (spreadsheet), redwood-credit-summary.pdf (pdf)

From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@acme.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 10:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Weekly MAP finance readout + credit ask (ACME)

Karthik —

Thanks for the clear summary. A few quick notes from procurement/finance side: 

- The $30k credit is higher than we typically expect for an initial production commitment. Our CFO will want to understand how that offsets implementation risk.
- Can the credit be staged (e.g., $15k at signature, $15k after successful handoff to our infra team)?
- We prefer credits applied against invoices, not as refunds.

I've attached our PO template to speed paperwork (ACME-PO-template.pdf). Procurement is targeting finalizing commercial terms by 11/15 if terms and credits are agreeable.

Also, two questions for Redwood:
1) If you can only approve $20k credit, are there alternative commercial levers (longer commit, smaller upfront payment) you can propose?
2) Who in Redwood signs for credits >$20k?

Lena and I will be on the Thursday call; we want to close this quarter but need a concrete, finance-approved offer to circulate.

Thanks,
Sanjay Rao
Head of AI, ACME Corp
sanjay.rao@acme.com

--
Attachment: ACME-PO-template.pdf

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: ACME credit ask (>$20k) — options and approval path

Karthik / Vivek / Marissa —

Per Karthik's note and Sanjay's reply: pricing team can provisionally approve up to $20k one-time credit at manager level for a signed 12-mo commit. Anything above $20k requires director-level approval + finance signoff.

Options to keep deal velocity without full $30k credit:
- Option A (preferred): Approve $20k credit + 10% discount on committed spend.
- Option B: Stage credit: $15k at signature, $10k after production handoff (requires a separate milestone clause).
- Option C: Offer extended onboarding services (no cash credit) to cover POC gap — e.g., 30 hours of Redwood professional services (equivalent value ~ $18k).

Requirements if >$20k credit requested:
- Marissa needs to route the proposed credit to Finance (including expected revenue recognition treatment) and get written sign-off by 11/10 to keep 11/15 contracting timeline.

I'll draft a short internal justification (pricing delta analysis) for Marissa to forward.

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
Principal Pricing Manager | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com

--
(Internal note: do not share this internal pricing matrix directly with procurement until we have Marissa/Finance approval.)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@acme.com>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@acme.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Weekly MAP finance readout + credit ask (ACME)

Sanjay / Lena —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and for sharing the PO template. I escalated the ask to Finance this morning. Summary of the outcome: 

- Finance is prepared to approve a one-time credit of $25,000 applied to the first two invoices, on the condition that we receive a signed agreement by 2026-11-15.
- Final approval requires a countersignature from the Redwood Finance Director; we have verbal confirmation and I'm securing the written sign-off today.

Proposed finalized commercial that keeps the procurement window intact:
- Commit: $100,000 ARR, 12 months
- Discount: 10% on committed spend
- One-time onboarding credit: $25,000 (applied to invoices per schedule)

Why this path: it preserves unit economics while giving ACME meaningful transition support. If ACME still prefers the $120k commit + $30k credit, we'll need Finance to sign off on the larger negative ARR delta — that will likely push approval beyond 11/10 and jeopardize the target signature date.

Next steps / asks:
- Karthik: please confirm whether ACME can accept $100k commit + 10% discount + $25k credit. If yes, send a revised term-sheet and I'll attach Finance's sign-off note.
- Sanjay: if procurement needs staged credit language (signature + milestone), we can accommodate that in the SOW.

I'll attach the draft term sheet (redwood-term-sheet-draft.docx) once Karthik confirms the commercial direction.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Sales Director | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0199

--
Attachments: redwood-term-sheet-draft.docx (draft term sheet)
